address.heading: Where to go
address.addressHtml: No physical address — join via the Zoom link in your calendar invite.

cards.title: 🪪 Photo ID
cards.body: Government-issued photo ID is required for identity verification if requested by your recruiter. No ID = we may need to reschedule.

cards.title: 📄 NDA
cards.body: No physical NDA. If required, your recruiter will send a DocuSign link ahead of time.

cards.title: 🚪 Arrival & departure
cards.body: When your interview block ends, you can leave the Zoom call. Your recruiter will share next steps by email.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.

paragraphs.html: Use the Zoom link in your calendar invite only. Do not share it publicly. Each session may use the same or different links — follow your schedule.

items: Join 2–3 minutes early — you'll wait in the waiting room
